program.major: Mechanical Engineering (Fluid Mechanics and Thermal Systems)

notes: Specialization confirmed to exist. Shares the fully-verified base Mechanical Engineering core. The specialization constrains 4 of the 5 technical electives; specialization elective list not individually re-verified course-by-course, hence medium confidence.

buckets.label: Materials/measurements course (choose 1)
buckets.note: One of MAE 160 or MAE 131B required.

buckets.label: Fluid Mechanics and Thermal Systems technical electives
buckets.note: 4 of these count as 4 of the 5 technical electives. Elective list not individually re-verified.

buckets.label: Humanities & Social Sciences / GE
buckets.note: Minimum 24 units. Engineering-major bucket that defers to the student's college General Education / Humanities & Social Sciences requirement (minimum 24 units). The qualifying course set is not defined by the MAE major; it is determined by the student's UCSD college (Revelle, Muir, Marshall, Warren, Roosevelt, Sixth, or Seventh), each of which publishes its own GE course list. Covered by the college GE section of the audit rather than a fixed major course list.
